A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same research work, with readable main text, figures, tables, equations, and Appendices A–E. Text extraction issues in the appendix tables were resolved through visual inspection.

before.justification: V1 reports original simulations, image reconstruction and clustering experiments, and few-shot classification results, including Figures 5–9 and Tables 4, 6, and 7.

after.justification: V2 retains these original experimental results in the main text and appendices.

M1.justification: FD, RFD, Flag-BMGS, the SVD/IRLS-SVD solvers, and the flag classifier remain unchanged. Algorithms 1–2 retain their procedures; the appendix revisions concern their mathematical description.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same synthetic scenarios, face reconstruction example, KSC and Indian Pines imagery, and EuroSat, CIFAR-10, and Flowers102 classification tasks. No dataset or evaluated scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged within corresponding experiments, including SVD/IRLS-SVD in outlier tests, QR/SVD in KSC clustering, and Euclidean/subspace few-shot classifiers. The newly cited flag-distance paper is not an evaluated baseline.

E3.justification: The metrics, flag dimensions, data sizes, splits, and model settings are retained. KSC still uses 326 patches and a 70/30 split; few-shot evaluation retains 3/5/7 shots, five ways, 100 tasks, and ten query images per task. Appendix clarifications do not establish changed experiments.

E4.justification: The additive-noise and outlier robustness tests, MDS analysis, face reconstruction example, and appendix comparisons using stacked versus final-layer baseline features are retained. No ablation or supplementary analysis is added or removed.

E5.justification: Tables 6–7 already report means and standard deviations over 20 random trials in v1 and retain this reporting in v2. Figure 9 also retains its trial information and variability display; no new statistical procedure is introduced.

E6.justification: Numerical results remain unchanged, but Section 5.5 revises the reported finding from improvement over baselines at all tested shots to similarity with subspace classifiers and improvements in two cases. This better matches Table 4, where seven-shot CIFAR-10 remains 68.0 for Flag, 68.6 for Euc., and 68.1 for Subsp.

T1.justification: Appendix A.1 replaces the general r,q objective with squared L2 and adds a rank condition. Appendix B corrects the orthogonality statement in v1 Proposition 5/v2 Proposition 7 and the matrix product in v1 Equation 42/v2 Equation 40. The added rank condition includes the unknown projector associated with X and appears inconsistent with the subsequent full-span basis extraction.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same central contributions: hierarchy-preserving Flag Decomposition, robust computation through Flag-BMGS, and applications to reconstruction, clustering, and few-shot learning.

C2.justification: Section 5.5 narrows the interpretation of few-shot performance from uniform superiority to near parity with subspace classifiers and limited gains. The existing limitations concerning numerical stability, required hierarchy and flag-type inputs, and future fine-tuning remain unchanged.

D1.justification: Appendix E.1 clarifies the outlier index set O, explicitly states reuse of the additive-noise coefficient-sampling scheme, and distinguishes the inlier reconstruction target. These refine reproduction instructions. Feature stacking and the implementation link were already documented in v1.

R1.justification: V2 adds Pitaval and Tirkkonen's 2013 paper, Flag orbit codes and their expansion to Stiefel codes, as a source for flag chordal distance. Appendix C also removes the equal-size hierarchy restriction previously attributed to MLMD; the broader positioning remains intact.

P1.justification: V2 makes localized prose, affiliation, and acknowledgement edits, divides Appendix A into numbered subsections, and reorders the existing Appendix B proofs so construction precedes the existence equivalence. Most narrative and section organization remain unchanged.

P2.justification: All nine figures and seven tables are retained. Tables 2 and 4–7 are resized or repositioned, Table 3's caption absorbs notation definitions from the text, and the author block and resulting text flow change. No new visual evidence is introduced.

improvement.justification: V2 describes the unchanged Table 4 results more faithfully and corrects several mathematical steps, giving a modest improvement in accuracy and clarity. The gain is limited by the problematic new rank condition in Appendix A.1, which depends on the optimization variable X. This defect is localized to the mathematical explanation; the operational algorithms and experimental evidence remain unchanged.
